name: bookmark-manager
description: Firefox add-on for finding and cleaning up duplicate, broken, redirected, unnamed and empty bookmarks.

scripts.lint: npm run bundle && npx --yes web-ext lint --ignore-files 'test/**' 'package.json' 'package-lock.json' 'README.md' 'node_modules/**' 'src/ui/query-editor.jsx'
scripts.start: npm run bundle && npx --yes web-ext run --ignore-files 'test/**' 'package.json' 'package-lock.json' 'README.md' 'node_modules/**' 'src/ui/query-editor.jsx'
scripts.build: npm run bundle && npx --yes web-ext build --overwrite-dest --ignore-files 'test/**' 'package.json' 'package-lock.json' 'README.md' 'node_modules/**' 'src/ui/query-editor.jsx'
